ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course will be held at the Morton Arboretum on Thursdays evenings from 6:00 to 9:00 PM. There will also be two Saturday labs on March 21 and April 4 from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM and an all day field trip in the Chicago area (location TBA) on Monday April 13. Class will not meet on March 26. This section is for M.S. students in NRES and AGED and graduate and undergraduate nondegree seeking students.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
